title: Inbox claims: recurrence finds a parked origin-conflict copy, the per-run resume reason has two homes, and parked conflicts are not listed
routed_reason: the inbox lifecycle and the resume rule; the console owns them
source: console, 2026-10-09, architecture delta check (round 2) of lane cl-inbox-claims, verdict Approve, MEDIUM and LOW items
summary: 1 (MEDIUM): recurrence/apply.go:197-221 findItem walks the whole inbox in lexical order and treats anything outside processing/ as open. origin-conflicts/ sorts before processing/, so an escalation for a claimed id finds the parked origin copy and acts on it. The same gap exists today for processed/. 2 (MEDIUM): the rule 'a per-run checkpoint needs a resumable reason' is written at inboxmover/holder.go:117 and core/resume.go:126. 3 (LOW): nothing lists or cleans .evolve/inbox/origin-conflicts/, so parked copies pile up without a word. 4 (LOW): ReleaseStaleClaims reads the goals map once per call.
fix: 1: findItem reads open items through lifecycle (the root only) and skips origin-conflicts/ and processed/, with a test. 2: give core.CheckpointResumable a per-run variant, so core owns the whole rule. 3: evolve inbox claims lists the parked origin copies and gives a count. 4: read the goals once per judged item, or accept it and record why.
acceptance: An escalation for a claimed id never acts on a parked or processed copy, with a test
The per-run resumable-reason rule has one home in core
evolve inbox claims shows parked origin conflicts
